source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 6 May 1902, p. 6 ("Crossmaglen Rural Council": nominations)
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: every name read from the page image; no other valid nomination, no poll

note: Triennial election of the Castleblayney No. 2 (Crossmaglen) rural district council, 1902: after withdrawals and invalid papers there was no contest. Dorsey: "no candidates nominated". Lisleitrim is not in the list. No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed. George Hughes was the only nomination for the division (two seats).
